title: China vs Australia, 2020–24: an 80.5% barley duty, 218% on wine, and a coal windfall for India
short: China's trade war on Australia, and how India got cheap coal
dek: After Australia called for a COVID-19 inquiry, China hit its wine, barley, coal and beef. Most of the trade found new buyers within months, and Indian coal users were among the winners.
card: Australian wine fell from 27.5% of China's wine imports to 0.14%. Its coal went to India instead.
